en-US.title: Baci - The Ecommerce Builder
en-US.subtitle: Sell Online & Manage Orders
en-US.description:
Baci is the ultimate mobile-first ecommerce builder for African entrepreneurs. Create your professional online store in minutes, manage products, track orders, and grow your business from anywhere.

INSTANT STORE CREATION
- Launch your online store in under 5 minutes
- Beautiful, professional templates
- Custom domain support (e.g., yourname.com)
- Mobile-optimized storefronts

PRODUCT & INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
- Add unlimited products with photos
- Track stock levels in real-time
- Barcode scanning support
- Variant management (sizes, colors)

ORDER TRACKING & FULFILLMENT
- Real-time order notifications
- Easy order status updates
- Customer communication tools
- Delivery tracking integration

MARKETING & AD TRACKING
- Sync offline conversions to Facebook (Meta), TikTok & Snapchat
- Track ad performance with Pixel integration
- Retarget customers effectively
- Measure true ROI on your campaigns

BUSINESS ANALYTICS
- Daily sales reports
- Revenue dashboards
- Customer insights
- Performance tracking

SCALE YOUR TEAM
- Multi-user staff accounts
- Role-based permissions
- Collaborative order management

GROW YOUR BUSINESS
- Accept online payments
- Customer management (CRM)
- Marketing tools
- Multi-platform selling

Perfect for:
- Small business owners
- Online sellers
- Retail shops going digital
- Side hustle entrepreneurs
- Fashion & lifestyle brands

Start selling online today with Baci!
